'''Vladimír Vonka''' (31 July 1930 – 20 June 2025) was a Czech [[virology|virologist]]. He worked in the field of [[anticarcinogen]] vaccines.

== Life and career ==
Vonka was born on 31 July 1930 in [[Prague]], [[Czechoslovakia]]. In 1947, he graduated from the Vančura Grammar School in Prague-[[Smíchov]]. He then graduated from the Faculty of Medicine of [[Charles University]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Vladimír Vonka (1930 - 2025) |url=https://www.memoryofnations.eu/en/vonka-vladimir-1930 |access-date=26 June 2025 |work=Memory of Nations|publisher=[[Post Bellum]]}}</ref>

Together with [[Gynaecology|gynaecologist]] Jiří Kaňka in the 1970s and 1980s, he led a study that contributed to the identification of the viral causative agent of [[cervical cancer]], which then enabled the development of the appropriate vaccine.<ref>{{Cite web |date=23 June 2025 |title=Zemřel virolog Vonka, přispěl k důkazu virového původu rakoviny děložního čípku|url=https://www.seznamzpravy.cz/clanek/domaci-zivot-v-cesku-zemrel-virolog-vonka-prispel-k-dukazu-viroveho-puvodu-rakoviny-delozniho-cipku-279990 |access-date=26 June 2025 |work=Seznam Zprávy |language=cs}}</ref>

He was one of the founding members of the [[Learned Society of the Czech Republic]], established in 1994.<ref name=learned>{{Cite web |title=Ve věku 94 let zemřel virolog prof. Vladimír Vonka|publisher=Učená společnost České republiky |url=https://www.learned.cz/cz/aktivity-spolecnosti/udalosti/ve-veku-94-let-zemrel-virolog-prof-vladimir-vonka.html |access-date=26 June 2025 |website=learned.cz}}</ref> In 2005, he received the [[Medal of Merit (Czech Republic)|Medal of Merit]] in the field of science from President [[Václav Klaus]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Seznam vyznamenaných |url=https://www.hrad.cz/cs/ceska-republika/statni-vyznamenani/medaile-za-zasluhy/seznam-vyznamenanych |access-date=26 June 2025 |publisher=Pražský hrad |language=cs}}</ref>  He was also a member of the [[European Academy of Sciences and Arts]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Members|publisher=European Academy of Sciences and Arts |url=https://euro-acad.eu/members |access-date=26 June 2025 |website=euro-acad.eu}}</ref>

Vonka died on 20 June 2025, at the age of 94.<ref name=learned/>
